scripts.build: npm run build -w @buhc/shared && npm run build -w @buhc/core && npm run build -w @buhc/api && npm run build -w @buhc/worker && npm run build -w @buhc/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @buhc/shared && npm run build -w @buhc/core && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @buhc/api" "npm run dev -w @buhc/worker" "npm run dev -w @buhc/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @buhc/shared && npm run build -w @buhc/core && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
